image.description: 4-D Tensor of shape `[batch, height, width, channels]` or 3-D Tensor of shape `[height, width, channels]`.

seed.description: A Python integer. Used to create a random seed. See `tf.compat.v1.set_random_seed` for behavior.
constraints: if provided, must be an integer

output.description: A tensor of the same type and shape as `image`.

constraints: output has the same type and shape as input
